deleted.$description: Text of a deleted plate (slice 3, decision 1): the plate stays in place, muted. Only the entry text is muted; the 'Deleted · Restore' line stays normal.

size-mark.$description: A quiet 'favorite' mark (a star) next to the time in the bottom right corner of the plate: the size of the time text (11 px, D2: was 10.4).

deleted-reserve.$description: Room for the 'Deleted · Restore' line at the end of the last text line of a deleted plate (110 px at a 13 px root: the line itself is about 100 px and the gap to the text about 10 px, as for the time; D2: was 104): wider than for the time, so the spacer of a deleted plate is longer.
